fields.label: Wallpaper fit
fields.description: How skwd-wall puts every wallpaper on the screen (applies to all wallpapers, not only kpopping ones). Auto fills the screen with landscape images and shows portrait or square ones whole.

fields.label: Around a fitted image
fields.description: What fills the bars beside a wallpaper that doesn't cover the whole screen (Fit, Center, Auto's portrait images).

fields.label: YouTube wallpaper quality
fields.description: Auto fetches at most your screen's resolution: more pixels than the screen has only cost decoding power. VP9 and H.264 are preferred over AV1 at that size, since many GPUs decode them in hardware but not AV1.

fields.label: Pause YouTube wallpaper when covered
fields.description: Pause the video while a fullscreen window (or, with skwd-wall's 'maximized' pause mode, a maximized one) covers its screen, and in game mode. Off: it keeps playing.
